description: Early-game detector: fires mostly in the first ~15 plies when columns 0 and 2 are still empty (column 1 may be used) and play is on the right side (cols 4-6 occupied), and the opponent's last move went to a low cell in column 5, 6 or 4. Stones in columns 0/2, a tall column 1, or the last stone stacking high in cols 4-6 switch it off. Rough, sequence-dependent; many exceptions.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changed move probabilities by at most 0.01 on four positions.
notes: Layer-0 unit. Band histograms: cols 0 and 2 empty in ~90% of top-band vs ~15-20% of bottom; strong ply decay. Last move column dominates in minimal pairs (col 5/6 best, 0/2 worst) but is context dependent; activation alternates ply-to-ply in some games. Scores: last-move rule F1 .25; additive weights .18; h0=h2=0 .31; combined score .30; final .34 (P .31 R .37, AUROC .67, sim share .11). Looks like a token-level mixture rather than a clean concept.
